_doc: Launcher events. Shown only while start <= now < end, on the player's clock. start/end are ISO 8601 with an offset (Lisbon: +00:00 in winter, +01:00 in summer). kind is free text; short is the 1-3 word label for the week strip. Leave the list empty when nothing runs: the strip then says NO EVENTS. Example entry: {"id":"exp-weekend","kind":"exp","short":{"en":"EXP ×2","pt":"EXP ×2"},"title":{"en":"Double EXP all weekend","pt":"EXP a dobrar todo o fim de semana"},"body":{"en":"...","pt":"..."},"start":"2026-11-13T18:00:00+00:00","end":"2026-11-15T23:59:00+00:00"}
